summary: Curated archive of 511 real website designs with screenshots, filterable by stack, category and style.
description: A handpicked archive of real websites worth studying, updated weekly with a newsletter of picks. Each entry tags the site's stack (Webflow, Next.js), its category (crypto, software, marketing, directory) and its visual style (dark, minimal, gradient, motion, typography), and links out to the live site. Separate galleries cover websites, apps and tools, logos, app icons and OG images.
